note: The Council of Ministers of 27 December 2012 set the cost of the CNIB at 2,500 F CFA, as Burkina24 reported; no later fee was found. The age it's issued from, its term and the time aren't stated, so it's offered at any age with those unknown.

sources.title: Burkina24, Le prix de la CNIB ramené à 2 500 F CFA (27 December 2012)
sources.said: Le coût de l’établissement de la Carte nationale d’identité burkinabè (CNIB) est désormais fixé à 2 500 F CFA. Le Conseil des ministres de ce 27 décembre 2012 en a décidé ainsi.
